<documents>
<document id="docs-account-details">
FindingˆyourˆaccountˆandˆroutingˆnumbersˆYourˆroutingˆnumberˆandˆaccountˆnumberˆareˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆAccountˆdetails.ˆYou'llˆneedˆthemˆforˆdirectˆdeposit,ˆtoˆlinkˆTallowbrookˆatˆanotherˆbank,ˆorˆtoˆreceiveˆaˆwire.ˆ##ˆWhereˆtoˆfindˆthemˆTapˆProfile,ˆthenˆAccountˆdetails.ˆTapˆtheˆeyeˆiconˆtoˆshowˆtheˆfullˆaccountˆnumber.ˆTheˆappˆasksˆyouˆtoˆconfirmˆit'sˆyouˆfirst.ˆ##ˆCardˆnumberˆversusˆaccountˆnumberˆYourˆcardˆnumberˆisˆdifferentˆfromˆyourˆaccountˆnumber.ˆDon'tˆgiveˆyourˆcardˆnumberˆtoˆanˆemployerˆforˆdirectˆdeposit.ˆ##ˆKeepingˆthemˆsafeˆOnlyˆgiveˆyourˆaccountˆandˆroutingˆnumbersˆtoˆpeopleˆandˆcompaniesˆyouˆtrust,ˆsuchˆasˆyourˆemployer.ˆSomeoneˆwithˆtheseˆnumbersˆcanˆtryˆtoˆpullˆmoneyˆbyˆACH.ˆIfˆthatˆhappens,ˆyouˆcanˆdisputeˆit.ˆ##ˆSupportˆwon'tˆreadˆthemˆoutˆForˆsecurity,ˆsupportˆwon'tˆreadˆyourˆfullˆaccountˆnumberˆorˆcardˆnumberˆtoˆyouˆinˆchatˆorˆonˆtheˆphone.ˆYouˆcanˆalwaysˆseeˆthemˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆ##ˆWireˆinstructionsˆForˆincomingˆwires,ˆuseˆtheˆWireˆinstructionsˆscreenˆunderˆAccountˆdetails,ˆwhichˆalsoˆshowsˆourˆSWIFTˆcodeˆforˆinternationalˆwires.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="close-statements">
StatementsˆafterˆclosingˆAfterˆyouˆcloseˆyourˆaccount,ˆyouˆcanˆstillˆsignˆinˆandˆdownloadˆstatementsˆforˆ90ˆdays.ˆ##ˆDownloadˆthemˆbeforeˆyouˆgoˆWeˆrecommendˆdownloadingˆanyˆstatementsˆandˆtaxˆformsˆyouˆmightˆneedˆbeforeˆyouˆclose.ˆTapˆProfile,ˆthenˆDocuments.ˆ##ˆAfterˆthatˆOnceˆtheˆdownloadˆperiodˆends,ˆyouˆcan'tˆsignˆin.ˆMessageˆsupportˆfromˆtheˆsign-inˆscreen,ˆorˆemailˆus,ˆandˆwe'llˆsendˆtheˆstatementsˆyouˆneed.ˆWeˆkeepˆrecordsˆforˆsevenˆyears.ˆ##ˆTaxˆformsˆIfˆyouˆearnedˆatˆleastˆ$10.00ˆinˆinterestˆinˆtheˆyearˆyouˆclosed,ˆweˆstillˆsendˆyourˆ1099-INTˆbyˆJanuaryˆ31.ˆ##ˆVerificationˆlettersˆAccountˆverificationˆlettersˆareˆonlyˆavailableˆforˆopenˆaccounts.ˆ##ˆCardˆandˆtransactionˆhistoryˆYourˆstatementsˆlistˆeveryˆtransaction,ˆfee,ˆinterestˆpaymentˆandˆdisputeˆcreditˆforˆtheˆmonth,ˆsoˆthey'reˆusuallyˆallˆyouˆneedˆforˆrecords,ˆtaxesˆorˆaˆloanˆapplicationˆelsewhere.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="card-renewal">
CardˆexpiryˆandˆrenewalˆWeˆmailˆaˆnewˆcardˆautomaticallyˆaboutˆ30ˆdaysˆbeforeˆyourˆcurrentˆcardˆexpires.ˆYouˆdon'tˆneedˆtoˆaskˆforˆit.ˆ##ˆWhatˆchangesˆTheˆrenewedˆcardˆhasˆtheˆsameˆcardˆnumber,ˆaˆnewˆexpiryˆdateˆandˆaˆnewˆsecurityˆcode.ˆMostˆmerchantsˆthatˆstoreˆyourˆcardˆgetˆtheˆnewˆexpiryˆdateˆautomatically,ˆbutˆsomeˆdon't,ˆsoˆcheckˆyourˆsubscriptions.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆwhenˆitˆarrivesˆActivateˆtheˆnewˆcardˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆYourˆoldˆcardˆkeepsˆworkingˆuntilˆyouˆactivateˆtheˆnewˆoneˆorˆuntilˆitˆexpires,ˆwhicheverˆcomesˆfirst.ˆ##ˆIfˆitˆdoesn'tˆarriveˆCheckˆthatˆyourˆaddressˆinˆtheˆappˆisˆcurrent.ˆIfˆyourˆoldˆcardˆexpiresˆandˆtheˆnewˆoneˆstillˆhasn'tˆarrived,ˆmessageˆsupportˆandˆwe'llˆsendˆanotherˆoneˆatˆnoˆcost.ˆ##ˆNoˆrenewal?ˆIfˆyourˆaccountˆisˆrestrictedˆorˆunderˆreview,ˆweˆcan'tˆsendˆaˆrenewalˆcardˆuntilˆthat'sˆresolved.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
